programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: From Rain to Remote Living in Costa Rica
programs.desc: A couple's ready to relocate from a rainy Vancouver to a waterfront home in Guanacaste, Costa Rica; they're looking for easy ocean access, and he wants something modern that's near town, but she prefers a place with Spanish style that's more remote.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: A Remote Water Home in Rangeley, Maine
programs.desc: Busy professionals and parents search for a remote waterfront home in Rangeley, Maine; he longs to be beyond the reach of cell service so he can truly relax, but she's more concerned about wild animals and easy access for their two young daughters.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: From RV to Oceanfront in Flagler Beach, Florida
programs.desc: After years of RV Florida vacations, a couple's ready for a full-time home on Flagler Beach. They both want a place that's right on the beach, and he's after something modern with a big garage, but she prefers a more traditional house.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: Loving Real Estate in Lake Elsinore, California
programs.desc: After relocating their business, real estate professionals search for a new home in Lake Elsinore, Calif.; they're looking for an active lifestyle and waterfront views; but finding a place that's best for both work and family may be a challenge.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: High Expectations in Show Low, Arizona
programs.desc: A couple sells their Idaho property to find an equivalent waterfront home near their two daughters in Show Low, Arizona; they want to choose the right place to begin their new life, but with high expectations, agreeing on a house may be a challenge.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: Looking for a Lakefront Family Home in Minnesota
programs.desc: High school pals reconnected and remarried, and now their blended family of seven is on the hunt for a lakefront home in Minnesota. They're looking for a house with a sandy beach on Mille Lacs Lake, but the rocky shoreline makes that a rarity.
